verdict.rationale: Ledgy's first-party pages say share awards can be granted "one by one, or in bulk" with contracts created, signed and shared in a few clicks, and that granting workflows can be automated in bulk. It also says historical transaction data can be brought into the cap table with documents attached. All of this is marketing-level copy, though, and the API evidence covers only reading cap-table data. Missing for 10: documented bulk upload mechanics (file format or template, validation, error handling) for historical transactions, any bulk write/import via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
